# History of the RHM experiment (2026-06-20 → 2026-07-30)

*Auto-generated by a research summarizer. This is a "big history" pass — see [README.md](README.md) for current results, [FILES.md](FILES.md) for the file index, and the linked auxiliary READMEs for full detail on any thread below.*

## Why RHM at all

The line starts from a dead end elsewhere: natural-language reduction experiments ([experiments/language_reduction](../language_reduction/STATUS.md)) showed vocab reduction is a channel intervention (changes β, not γ) and that spectral denoising was entangled with the statistics being measured — there was no clean way to actually change language's data-generating process (DGP). The Random Hierarchy Model (Cagnetta & Wyart) is adopted specifically to buy **ground truth**: a synthetic DGP with a known hierarchy, so DGP interventions (depth `L`, synonymic multiplicity `m`) can be cleanly separated from channel interventions (vocab `v`), and every activation can be graded against the process that generated it rather than inferred statistically. This ground-truth availability is what every later arc exploits, and its absence is what repeatedly trips up naive ports from other domains.

## Era 1 — Building the instruments (06-20 → 06-21)

The opening moves are calibration, not discovery: a scaling-exponent sweep establishes that **`m` dominates `L` ~3:1** as the scaling bottleneck ([SWEEP_README.md](SWEEP_README.md)), and a forward-model (FM) residual-rank probe is built to ask whether a model's "leftover" computation reflects DGP complexity ([RESIDUAL_RANK_README.md](RESIDUAL_RANK_README.md)). The rank instrument immediately teaches a lesson that recurs all arc long: apparent signal can be an artifact of *how well the FM is doing its job*, not of the thing being measured (rank tracks learning quality, and later rank *rises* with FM capacity — backwards from the naive prediction). Per-level loss decomposition ([PER_LEVEL_LOSS_README.md](PER_LEVEL_LOSS_README.md)) then supplies the arc's most durable mechanistic picture: **models learn the hierarchy bottom-up**, and a "composition depth ceiling" — a model that masters level 0 but plateaus after 1-2 levels — appears immediately at modest scale and turns out to be a capacity fact, not a training-dynamics quirk. The regime-trajectory experiments locate a sweet spot (**L=6, m=4, 6L/6H/192D**) where this ceiling is actually observable and adopt it as the default hyperparameter setting for everything downstream ([REGIME_TRANSITION_README.md](REGIME_TRANSITION_README.md)).

## Era 2 — Can the objective move the ceiling? (06-22 → 06-23)

With the ceiling established as a fact about capacity, the natural next question is whether the *training objective* — not more parameters — can relocate it. Label smoothing, which caps NTP's sharpening reward, is tested first and fails cleanly: it hurts every level, including the ones it was meant to free up capacity for ([LABEL_SMOOTHING_README.md](LABEL_SMOOTHING_README.md)) — **the ceiling is a capacity constraint, not an objective-induced bias.** But a *complementary* axis — reweighting gradient by position confidence (focal loss, confidence thresholding) rather than by sharpness — has a real, different effect: it preserves compositional learning while making the model's computation more legible to an FM ([LOSS_WEIGHTING_README.md](LOSS_WEIGHTING_README.md)). Replacing the heuristic focal-γ with a co-trained FM's own prediction error as the reweighting signal (FM-surprise-weighted NTP) pushes this further, reaching FM cosine 0.995 — the first hint that a model's own forward self-model can usefully shape its training, which becomes the seed of the arc that follows.

## Era 3 — The Ratchet: does self-improvement compound here? (06-23 → 06-29)

The MNIST "gated ratchet" (inject an FM forecast → distill → repeat) compounds 34%→48% over 4 cycles. This arc ports that loop to RHM and spends a week failing to reproduce the *magnitude* while reproducing every *qualitative* dynamic (gate closing, brittleness, crossover timing) — a pattern that itself becomes the finding. Sparsifying supervision (masking NTP) isolates the true lever: dense per-position NTP already supervises everything a local loss could add, so sparsity — not capacity — gates whether self-distillation helps at all ([ratchet/RHM_SPARSITY_SWEEP_README.md](ratchet/RHM_SPARSITY_SWEEP_README.md)). Even the sparse ratchet's real win (+1.2% at 95% masking) doesn't *compound* — it dissipates by cycle 4 instead of building. Reframing NTP as merely "sparse, not rich" motivates a switch to RL supervision, which produces striking dynamics (self-knowledge finally beats open-loop) but the same non-compounding refusal survives a 40-cycle extension ([ratchet/RHM_RL_RATCHET_README.md](ratchet/RHM_RL_RATCHET_README.md), [ratchet/RHM_RL_GEN_DISTILL_EXTENDED_README.md](ratchet/RHM_RL_GEN_DISTILL_EXTENDED_README.md)). A FOMAML diagnostic finally settles the mechanism: on **stationary** data the outer loop is mathematically identical to the inner loop, so no outer objective can make FM-predictability pressure improve composition ([ratchet/RHM_FOMAML_README.md](ratchet/RHM_FOMAML_README.md)). **Crystallized belief: compounding requires a moving frontier — novel rules or deepening levels — that a fixed RHM corpus structurally cannot supply once it saturates.** ([ratchet/README.md](ratchet/README.md)) This single sentence redirects everything that follows.

## Era 4 — Reframing: the wrong tool, the right knob, the right target (~06-29 → 07-01)

Rather than treat the ratchet's failure as terminal, [RHM_DEEP_COMPOSITION_README.md](RHM_DEEP_COMPOSITION_README.md) re-diagnoses it: next-token prediction was the wrong instrument all along, conflating three nested bottlenecks (does the signal exist / is it extractable / does it transfer across instances). Training-free probes show deep structure *is* recoverable and *representable*, but no self-supervised local objective reaches it — "infer a deep subtree" simply *is* the diluted long-range inference such an objective would need to already solve. [RHM_FRONTIER_AND_LEGIBILITY_README.md](RHM_FRONTIER_AND_LEGIBILITY_README.md) then finds the actual lever: matched-occupancy settings with wildly different learned recovery prove **`m` gates learnability**, not occupancy — and on the resulting easy (m=2) substrate, the FM residual becomes hierarchy-legible in a bottom-up traveling front, confirming the wake-sleep loop *amplifies* structure NTP already extracts rather than manufacturing it (and retroactively explaining every earlier RHM null as having run where m≥4 left nothing to amplify). [RHM_LATENT_LOOP_README.md](RHM_LATENT_LOOP_README.md) delivers the arc's sharpest reversal: closing the self-knowledge loop on a **token** target inverts self-knowledge on RHM (as every prior attempt found); the same loop on a **latent** (own-DGP) target produces RHM's first-ever genuine, generalizable self-knowledge. What matters is not residual depth but residual *FM-invariance* — whether the residual is DGP-aligned versus FM-idiosyncratic noise.

## Era 5 — Does self-knowledge actually do anything? (07-01, 07-07)

Given a substrate (m=2) where self-knowledge is finally real, [RHM_FM_REGULARIZER_README.md](RHM_FM_REGULARIZER_README.md) asks if it's *load-bearing*: does structured FM-predictability pressure compress a model's functional circuit where plain weight decay cannot? Yes — WD hits a floor around 52.6% activation rank no amount of decay moves, while the FM regularizer reaches 42.9% with knowledge preserved. But the paper's own framing sharpens the interpretation: **self-knowledge is not required** — the simplest open-loop pressure (no injection, no distillation) suffices, so "self-knowledge helps" and "closing a loop is necessary" turn out to be separate claims. [RHM_COMPLEXODYNAMICS_README.md](RHM_COMPLEXODYNAMICS_README.md) reads the same saved trajectories against Aaronson's "First Law of Complexodynamics" (rise-then-fall of sophistication) and confirms it with two amendments: the descent needs an annealer (SGD alone freezes mid-descent, "a glass, not a liquid"), and it bottoms out not at zero but at the **DGP's own sophistication** — a floor, not a truncated transient. This hump-vs-floor distinction (trajectory-owned scaffolding vs. problem-owned complexity) becomes a recurring lens for the rest of the project.

## Era 6 — A side note on chunking (07-03)

A sibling thread, deliberately decoupled from the FM machinery, tests a motor-chunking hypothesis from [a2a_forward](../a2a_forward/README.md): does squeezing activations through a capacity "waist" produce hierarchical chunking? [SLEEP_CHUNKING_RHM_README.md](SLEEP_CHUNKING_RHM_README.md) finds a clean dissociation — a generic reconstruction waist keeps surface detail and discards abstraction (the opposite of chunking), while the same squeeze under an **external-role** objective (predict what comes next, not reconstruct what's here) inverts the ordering into clean top-down chunking. **The objective, not the capacity squeeze, is what makes a waist chunk** — a small result that foreshadows the "grounded vs. endogenous target" dichotomy that dominates the sculpting arc below.

## Era 7 — Is RHM even a control problem? (07-10 → 07-11)

[ACTIVE_RHM_README.md](ACTIVE_RHM_README.md) ports the a2a reaching arc's active-inference machinery (an agent that chooses *which* masked blocks to reveal) back to RHM and finds a structural mismatch: the arity *impossibility* ports (a belief-only FM can't represent query-conditional structure), but arity *usability* doesn't — a mean-Δ FM is a planning null because value-of-information lives in the *variance* of an update, which point-estimate training discards. Replacing the target with the decision variable itself (expected posterior entropy, i.e. greedy Bayesian experimental design) fixes it at m=2, and a computable diagnostic (per-instance query-rank correlation) predicts in advance whether a setting is plannable at all. Phase 4 then asks whether "internalizing" the forward model — the reaching arc's headline trick — has any purchase here, and finds **no headroom**: a plain controller already saturates the observation-decodable VoI at every m. The reason is structural and becomes a load-bearing belief: **internalization reorganizes representations only when acting and forecasting are separable computations a model-free learner can shortcut (control); active-query RHM is inference in disguise, where act ≈ plan, so there is nothing to internalize.**

## Era 8 — Escaping act ≈ plan: sculpting (07-11 → 07-16)

If querying can't showcase internalization, editing might: [sculpting_control_task.md](sculpting_control_task.md) validates, with a perfect-simulator pre-check, that an edit-toward-a-target task genuinely requires coordination a myopic reflex cannot supply. [RHM_SCULPTING_README.md](RHM_SCULPTING_README.md)'s main arc self-corrects once (an apparent "task is greedy-decomposable" negative turns out to be an artifact of grading against a witness-targeted oracle rather than the true DP optimum) and then produces a scoped-negative-predicts-the-positive result of its own: latent-space planning only *approximates* token-space planning on a clean channel (tokens are already sufficient), but reliably *beats* it once the channel is lossy or stochastic — confirming a falsifiable prediction made from understanding the first negative. Stages 4-5 rediscover Era 6's dichotomy in a new register: **endogenous/self-referential belief targets cap the planning frontier; grounded targets move it.** [RHM_SCULPT_CONTINUAL_README.md](RHM_SCULPT_CONTINUAL_README.md) tests whether this compounds and finds a weak ratchet — value iteration is the real engine, one-shot internalization only sets a ceiling that "exhausts in one pass" on fixed data, echoing Era 3's moving-frontier conclusion yet again. [specialization/README.md](specialization/README.md) then delivers the arc's sharpest RHM-vs-language disanalogy: even a *direct* deep training target concentrated on a subtree fails to specialize a model, because RHM's single shared ruleset has no domain-specific deep structure to specialize into ("broad beats narrow") — planting the exact problem `directed_sculpting` later has to solve by engineering heterogeneity in.

## Era 9 — What does a self-report actually track? (07-22)

[confabulation/README.md](confabulation/README.md) forks the latent-loop's wake recipe to give the Nisbett-Wilson introspection-skepticism argument a testable operationalization: since `a_j = FM(a_i) + r`, everything a *learned self-theory* could produce lives in `FM(a_i)`, so genuine implementation-tracking must live in the residual `r`. The result is a genuine positive — a self-report head has a first-person advantage only on the residual-determined target, is a dead null on behavior, and is *beaten* by a third-party observer on world-state, exactly as the "not cheaply I/O-recoverable" criterion predicts. A self-correction mid-arc (an initial 12× closed-loop advantage turns out to be a pooling artifact; the true gap is ~+9%) reinforces the era's real lesson: **closing the loop changes how well a model knows itself, not what there is to know.**

## Era 10 — Retiring an instrument (07-27)

[residual_decomposition/README.md](residual_decomposition/README.md) revisits Era 1's founding rank instrument across RHM, language, and vision and falsifies its core premise: what looked like "rank reflecting DGP complexity" was actually the FM's **noise floor** — residual variance obeys `res_var ∝ act_var^β` with β invariant to FM capacity, while naive rank inflates toward 94-96% of `d_model` in exactly the regime where the FM has essentially solved the task. This single relationship retroactively explains three separate historical rank "negatives" across three different experiments and domains as the same artifact. The instrument of record becomes two decoupled numbers — **β** (shape) and **`R_res_participation`** (a basis-weighted frontier dimensionality) — replacing the single `R_res` figure used everywhere in Eras 1-5.

## Era 11 — A real control task, and its own version of the belief/ground-truth split (07-11 WIP → 07-28/07-29)

[RHM_EDIT_CONTROL_README.md](RHM_EDIT_CONTROL_README.md) is explicitly Era 7's deferred next step: make RHM a genuine control task where actions change the world. The mean-Δ FM that was a near-null on epistemic queries becomes a decisive planner on edits — the predicted mirror image — but grading belief-optimal runs against the *true* grammar reveals near-zero true success even as belief confidence saturates: a second, independent controllability axis (off-manifold belief-gaming) that reaching never had to confront. [directed_sculpting/README.md](directed_sculpting/README.md) hits a structurally identical wall porting an unrelated design (mjc's E3 loop): RHM's rule usage is uniform by construction, so there is no relevance signal to allocate over until distractor channels and support-fixed drift are engineered in — and a repair-cost instrument reveals raw cross-entropy is *exactly, algebraically* blind to the resulting drift (`KL(w‖uniform) = log m − H(w)`), a trap the project explicitly flags as a standing property to watch for again. [directed_sculpting/full_loop/README.md](directed_sculpting/full_loop/README.md) then finds a genuine positive (a reward-free relevance signal separates real from distractor tokens 13-18× and recovers 76% of an oracle's advantage) alongside a headline negative repaired twice before it would hold: **expansion is a property of the grader's type (grounded vs. endogenous — Era 6/8's dichotomy again), not of non-stationarity itself.** The arc's final move reframes even that null: surface re-fit was silently repairing 91% of each drift event, so starving samples-per-event at fixed drift magnitude finally produces the project's first positive on the climbing axis — depth advantage migrating from surface to deep levels.

## Where the priors sit now

Four beliefs have been earned the hard way across this line and now shape how new RHM experiments get designed: (1) **compounding requires a moving frontier**, not more loop machinery, on stationary data; (2) **self-knowledge and closing a loop are separable claims** — pressure toward predictability can do real work (functional compression, chunking, control) without injection or distillation; (3) **internalization is a control-task phenomenon**, purchase-free wherever acting already equals planning; (4) **RHM's uniformity is a standing confound**, not a neutral default — any experiment porting a design that assumes heterogeneous, non-stationary structure (a2a's reaching, mjc's E3) must engineer that heterogeneity into the DGP explicitly, or the null it produces will look like a finding.
